title: Asterion difficulty and learning curves: skill by use, the death penalty and the long curve of a Tibia-like MMORPG
summary: Difficulty, learning and power curves for Asterion, a Tibia-like MMORPG for five friends: the cubic exp curve, skills by use, the 10 % death penalty and the corpse run, traced through Tibia, Ultima Online, EverQuest, RuneScape and their modern heirs into a Curve Spec, a playtest protocol, a curve lab and an Asterion Atlas of every creature, item and spell.
